limitations: No publication linked; Methods rely on the PRIDE protocol text.
B=on-bead and F=FASP mapping is inferred from the protocol and file/experiment naming; deposit does not label them explicitly.
Two groups (P3665-P3687, P3617-P3640; 24 files) cannot be tied to a preparation method.
Fractionation method, collision energy (25% NCE), reduction/alkylation reagents, LC settings not encoded as optional columns.
